muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿سأل﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, containing the meaning of دعا (to call for); for that reason it is made transitive the way that verb is made transitive.
﴿سائل﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿بعذاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سأل﴾.
﴿واقع﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿للكافرين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿واقع﴾.
﴿ليس﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of laysa.
﴿دافع﴾: the postponed ism (noun) of laysa; and the clause ﴿ليس له دافع﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عذاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿واقع﴾, or attached to ﴿دافع﴾.
﴿ذي﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ, because it is one of the five nouns.
﴿المعارج﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿تعرج﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; and تعرج is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الملائكة﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative.
﴿والروح﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الملائكة.
﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعرج﴾.
﴿في يوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted element indicated by واقع, i.e.: "the punishment will befall them on the Day of Resurrection".
﴿كان﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿مقداره﴾: the ism (noun) of kāna, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿خمسين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿ألف﴾: tamyīz (specification) of خمسين.
﴿سنة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فاصبر﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); and اصبر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿صبرًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿جميلا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إنهم﴾: inna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿هم﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿يرونه﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause يرونه is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿بعيدًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because the "seeing" is cognitive (ʿilmiyya); and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ونراه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; and ﴿نراه﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قريبًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, because the "seeing" is cognitive (ʿilmiyya).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قريبًا﴾, or to an omitted element indicated by ﴿واقع﴾, i.e.: "it will befall on the day when … will be".
﴿تكون﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿تكون﴾ is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿السماء﴾: the ism (noun) of تكون, nominative.
﴿كالمهل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكون; and ﴿المهل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وتكون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; and ﴿تكون﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿تكون﴾ is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by conjunction with the preceding clause.
﴿الجبال﴾: the ism (noun) of ﴿تكون﴾, nominative.
﴿كالعهن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾; and ﴿العهن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating.
﴿يسأل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿حميم﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿حميما﴾: the first object of يسأل, the second object being omitted, its implied form being: "his intercession" and "his help". It has also been said: حميما is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and يسأل has no need of an object.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يبصرونهم﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). It has been made transitive to a second object by the doubling (of the middle radical), and the first object has taken the place of the agent. The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), or an attribute (ṣifa), i.e.: "relatives being made to see (them)".
﴿يود﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿المجرم﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿لو يفتدي﴾: لو is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) in the sense of أن, because it comes after a verb of wishing; together with what falls within its scope it is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the object of يودّ, i.e.: "he wishes to ransom (himself)".
﴿من عذاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفتدي﴾.
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, its implied form being: "on the day when the sky will be like molten brass, and the mountains will be like wool, and no intimate friend will ask about an intimate friend".
﴿ببنيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, likewise attached to ﴿يفتدي﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وصاحبته﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بنيه, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأخيه﴾: likewise conjoined, genitive by the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وفصيلته﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بنيه, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿فصيلته﴾.
﴿تؤويه﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma because of heaviness; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and the clause ﴿تؤويه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ومن﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf); and من is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause); and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿جميعًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī).
﴿ينجيه﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma because of heaviness; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إنها﴾: inna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿ها﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لظى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿نزاعة﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in لظى, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿للشوى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزاعة﴾; genitive (majrūr) by an implied kasra on the alif.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿تدعو﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma because of heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) of تدعو is latent (mustatir), referring to لظى; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in نزّاعة.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أدبر﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent; and the clause ﴿أدبر﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿تولى﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أدبر.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وجمع﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and جمع is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿فأوعى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أوعى is a past verb; its fāʿil is latent.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الإنسان﴾: the ism (noun) of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the overt fatḥa; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir); and the clause خلق is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿هلوعا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil, accusative.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its response ﴿جزوعًا﴾.
﴿مسه﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause مسّه is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿الشر﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿جزوعًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿هلوعًا﴾, the implied sense being: "anxious, being impatient at the time evil touches him". It has also been said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿هلوعًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its response ﴿منوعا﴾.
﴿مسه﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿مسّه﴾ is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿الخير﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿منوعا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿هلوعا﴾, the implied sense being: "anxious, being withholding at the time good touches him". It has also been said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿هلوعا﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿المصلين﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿على صلاتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دائمون﴾.
﴿دائمون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of هم, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause ﴿هم على صلاتهم دائمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿في أموالهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿حق﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿معلوم﴾: a naʿt, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿في أموالهم حق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿للسائل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حق﴾.
﴿والمحروم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the genitive noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السائل, genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿يصدقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause يُصَدِّقُون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بيوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدقون﴾.
﴿الدين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من عذاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying: ﴿مشفقون﴾.
﴿ربهم﴾: رب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and is itself muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿مشفقون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; and the clause ﴿هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿عذاب﴾: the ism (noun) of inna, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ربهم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿غير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿مأمون﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لفروجهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحافظون﴾. [Translator's note: the word in this ayah is ﴿حافظون﴾; ﴿يحافظون﴾ belongs to ayah 34 (﴿على صلاتهم يحافظون﴾).]
﴿حافظون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿على أزواجهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element which is the excepted (mustathnā), i.e.: "except their guarding them with regard to their wives"; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by conjunction with أزواجهم.
﴿ملكت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; and the clause ﴿ملكت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أيمانهم﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فإنهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿هم﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿غير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿ملومين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts into the jussive (ism sharṭ jāzim), a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ابتغى﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to من.
﴿وراء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ابتغى﴾, for وراء has here left its adverbial use, i.e.: "he sought what is beyond that", i.e. (beyond) enjoyment through marriage and what the right hand possesses. You may also keep it as an adverb and attach it to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "whoever seeks a matter lying beyond that".
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the conditional noun.
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿هم﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿العادون﴾: the khabar of أولئك; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. Or هم is a second mubtadaʾ and العادون its khabar, and that clause is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لأماناتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راعون﴾; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وعهدهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and عهدهم is conjoined to أماناتهم, genitive (majrūr); and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿راعون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بشهاداتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قائمون﴾; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قائمون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿الذين﴾, which is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿على صلاتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحافظون﴾; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يحافظون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿في جنات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), or attached to ﴿مكرمون﴾.
﴿مكرمون﴾: a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فمال﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and the lām is a preposition, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive; and the preposition and its genitive noun form a quasi-clause (shibh jumla) in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ما.
﴿كفروا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma; and the wāw is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿قبلك﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to ﴿مهطعين﴾, i.e.: "being in the direction adjoining you, on the right and on the left".
﴿مهطعين﴾: ḥāl from الذين, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿عن اليمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; it has also been said: attached to ﴿مهطعين﴾.
﴿وعن الشمال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿عن الشمال﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿عن اليمين﴾.
﴿عزين﴾: likewise a ḥāl from the relative noun, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿أيطمع﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and يطمع is an imperfect verb.
﴿كل﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿امرئ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿امرئ﴾.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; أن with what falls within its scope is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the (implied) preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يطمع﴾, i.e.: "does he hope for entering?"
﴿يُدخل﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), in the subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿جنة﴾: a second object, by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿نعيم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إنا﴾: inna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿خلقناهم﴾: a past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause خلقناهم is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿مما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقناهم﴾.
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; and the clause يعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿فلا أقسم برب المشارق والمغارب﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لا is connective (ṣila); أقسم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "I" (أنا); and برب المشارق والمغارب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسم﴾.
﴿إنا لقادرون﴾: inna is an abrogating particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and قادرون is the khabar (predicate) of inna; and the clause إنّا لقادرون has no grammatical position, because it is the response to the oath.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿على﴾: a preposition, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿نبدل﴾: an imperfect verb in the subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾; أن with what falls within its scope is in the position of the genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادرون﴾.
﴿خيرًا﴾: the object of نبدل.
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa.
﴿نحن﴾: the ism (noun) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿بمسبوقين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿مسبوقين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position, genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿فذرهم﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); ذرهم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يخوضوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is the response to the command; and the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿ويلعبوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يخوضوا.
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition.
﴿يلاقوا﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the wāw is the fāʿil; and the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذرهم.
﴿يومهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يومهم﴾.
﴿يوعدون﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; and the wāw is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿يوم﴾: يوم is a badal (substitute) of ﴿يومهم﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿يخرجون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn the nūn [Translator's note: the word «النون» is repeated in the source]; the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); and the clause يخرجون is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿من الأجداث﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجون﴾.
﴿سراعًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, accusative.
﴿كأنهم﴾: kaʾanna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿هم﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿إلى نصب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوفضون﴾.
﴿يوفضون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; and the clause يوفضون is the khabar (predicate) of كأنهم; and the clause كأنهم is a second ḥāl, likewise from the wāw, so that the two ḥāls are successive (mutarādifa), or from the pronoun in ﴿سراعًا﴾, so that they are nested (mutadākhila).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿خاشعة﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), from the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يوفضون﴾ or from the fāʿil of ﴿يخرجون﴾; the first is closer.
﴿أبصارهم﴾: the fāʿil of خاشعة, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ترهقهم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; the hāʾ of ﴿ترهقهم﴾ is in fact the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).]
﴿ذلة﴾: fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause ﴿ترهقهم ذلة﴾ is a second ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿اليوم﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as an attribute (ṣifa).
﴿كانوا﴾: kāna is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its ism (noun).
﴿يوعدون﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), nominative by the retention of the nūn; and the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause ﴿يوعدون﴾ is the khabar of kāna. The clause ﴿كانوا يوعدون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. And the clause ﴿ذلك اليوم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
